const sid = ($json && $json.replies) ? $json.replies[0].duplicateSheet.properties.sheetId : 289797341;
const requests = [
  {updateSheetProperties:{properties:{sheetId:sid,gridProperties:{hideGridlines:true,frozenRowCount:1}},fields:"gridProperties.hideGridlines,gridProperties.frozenRowCount"}},
  {updateBorders:{range:{sheetId:sid,startRowIndex:0,endRowIndex:11,startColumnIndex:0,endColumnIndex:18},top:{style:"NONE"},bottom:{style:"NONE"},left:{style:"NONE"},right:{style:"NONE"},innerHorizontal:{style:"NONE"},innerVertical:{style:"NONE"}}},
  {repeatCell:{range:{sheetId:sid,startRowIndex:1,endRowIndex:11,startColumnIndex:0,endColumnIndex:1},cell:{userEnteredFormat:{numberFormat:{type:"DATE",pattern:"dd.MM.yyyy"}}},fields:"userEnteredFormat.numberFormat"}},
  {repeatCell:{range:{sheetId:sid,startRowIndex:1,endRowIndex:11,startColumnIndex:13,endColumnIndex:14},cell:{userEnteredFormat:{numberFormat:{type:"DATE",pattern:"dd.MM.yyyy"}}},fields:"userEnteredFormat.numberFormat"}},
  {repeatCell:{range:{sheetId:sid,startRowIndex:1,endRowIndex:11,startColumnIndex:2,endColumnIndex:3},cell:{userEnteredFormat:{numberFormat:{type:"NUMBER",pattern:"#,##0"}}},fields:"userEnteredFormat.numberFormat"}},
  {repeatCell:{range:{sheetId:sid,startRowIndex:1,endRowIndex:11,startColumnIndex:6,endColumnIndex:10},cell:{userEnteredFormat:{numberFormat:{type:"NUMBER",pattern:"#,##0"}}},fields:"userEnteredFormat.numberFormat"}},
  {repeatCell:{range:{sheetId:sid,startRowIndex:1,endRowIndex:11,startColumnIndex:3,endColumnIndex:6},cell:{userEnteredFormat:{numberFormat:{type:"PERCENT",pattern:"0.00%"}}},fields:"userEnteredFormat.numberFormat"}},
  {repeatCell:{range:{sheetId:sid,startRowIndex:1,endRowIndex:11,startColumnIndex:10,endColumnIndex:11},cell:{userEnteredFormat:{numberFormat:{type:"NUMBER",pattern:"0.00"}}},fields:"userEnteredFormat.numberFormat"}},
  {updateDimensionProperties:{range:{sheetId:sid,dimension:"ROWS",startIndex:0,endIndex:1},properties:{pixelSize:38},fields:"pixelSize"}},
  {updateDimensionProperties:{range:{sheetId:sid,dimension:"ROWS",startIndex:1,endIndex:11},properties:{pixelSize:42},fields:"pixelSize"}},
  {addConditionalFormatRule:{rule:{ranges:[{sheetId:sid,startRowIndex:1,endRowIndex:11,startColumnIndex:12,endColumnIndex:13}],booleanRule:{condition:{type:"CUSTOM_FORMULA",values:[{userEnteredValue:"=$N2<=3"}]},format:{backgroundColor:{red:0.9569,green:0.8,blue:0.8}}}},index:0}},
  {addConditionalFormatRule:{rule:{ranges:[{sheetId:sid,startRowIndex:1,endRowIndex:11,startColumnIndex:12,endColumnIndex:13}],booleanRule:{condition:{type:"CUSTOM_FORMULA",values:[{userEnteredValue:"=AND($N2>=4;$N2<=7)"}]},format:{backgroundColor:{red:1,green:0.949,blue:0.8}}}},index:1}},
  {addConditionalFormatRule:{rule:{ranges:[{sheetId:sid,startRowIndex:1,endRowIndex:11,startColumnIndex:12,endColumnIndex:13}],booleanRule:{condition:{type:"CUSTOM_FORMULA",values:[{userEnteredValue:"=$N2>=8"}]},format:{backgroundColor:{red:0.851,green:0.918,blue:0.827}}}},index:2}}
];
return [{ json: { body: JSON.stringify({ requests }), sid } }];

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.time_log_staging (
  id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  project_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  session_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
  date DATE NOT NULL,
  stage TEXT NOT NULL,
  executor TEXT NOT NULL,
  task_section TEXT,
  hours NUMERIC NOT NULL,
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  confirmed_at TIMESTAMPTZ
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_time_log_staging_proj_status ON public.time_log_staging (project_id, status);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_time_log_staging_session ON public.time_log_staging (session_id, status);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.money_log_staging (
  id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  project_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  session_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
  date DATE NOT NULL,
  stage TEXT,
  counterparty TEXT NOT NULL,
  amount NUMERIC NOT NULL,
  type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (type IN ('оплата_субпідряднику','надходження_від_замовника','акт_підписаний')),
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  confirmed_at TIMESTAMPTZ
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_money_log_staging_proj_status ON public.money_log_staging (project_id, status);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_money_log_staging_session ON public.money_log_staging (session_id, status);
